docs.purpose: The operator's directory of every account. It searches by email, phone, name or company and filters by account persona, subscription status, trade, and whether a subscription cancellation failed at the payment provider. Results are paged by the server, and each row opens that account's detail page. A button opens a small form for creating a supplier or enterprise account directly.
docs.data_story: It reads nothing from the database directly. Every value arrives through one contract: `/api/admin/users`. Behind that contract, the data comes from `entitlements` and `user_profiles`, and writes land on `admin_audit_log`, `entitlements` and `user_profiles`.
docs.under_126: **REBUILD** — it drives writes, so a client decision has to be re-homed on the server before the projection can be honest. It renders through the LIST renderer (a collection with declared pagination, recycling and empty/offline states), reading by reference: `/api/admin/users`. It owns no component of its own, so its `owns.components[]` is an empty array — a legal answer, written down.

versioning.why: GET returns the raw joined rows and the column whitelist lives in the SQL, so adding a column adds a field to every consumer; removing one breaks the directory table silently.

inputs.why: One contract, with the filter set serialised into a query string by the directory hook; the page reads no table.

outputs.why: Create provisions the account server-side — GoTrue user, user_profiles row and an admin_managed entitlement in one transaction — and the directory waits for the created row plus its one-time reset link.
outputs.rollback: The route deletes the freshly created GoTrue user if the transaction fails. There is no rollback once it commits: an unwanted account is retired through the detail page's delete branch, not undone here.

state.why: useUserDirectoryStore owns the filters and the paging offset (Layer 3) on top of the root provider's Layer-2 cache; offset is a raw row offset, not a page index.

staleness.why: 15s staleTime with a one-hour gcTime, so paging back to a previous filter set is instant while a directory left open still refreshes quickly.

session.why: There is no admin Postgres role: classifyRoute sends every /admin/* path down the admin arm, and the real boundary is verifyAdminAuth reading profiles.is_admin on the route. Both handlers verify on their first line and POST additionally refuses the x-admin-key credential, so an account cannot be provisioned by a CI token.

rls_class.why: user_profiles is one of the ten auth.uid()-owned Class-A tables and admin_audit_log is the admin-identity subtype; a directory that lists every user's rows is only possible through the service role.

checks.why: POST writes a create_account row to admin_audit_log naming the preset, the trades and whether an existing auth user was adopted.
The create response carries a live password-reset link, so the route sets Cache-Control: no-store on it — the only response in the shard that does.

A filter set that matches nobody must render the declared empty state; the stripe_cancel_failed filter is a sweep surface whose normal answer is zero rows, and a blank table would read as a broken page.

The page destructures the whole store in one call rather than reading atomic selectors, so any filter change re-renders the directory — acceptable at this size, named here so it is not mistaken for the Flight Center's pattern.

errors.why: Create failures raise a sonner toast and keep the modal open with its input; a failed directory read renders inline in the table area.

classes.ui: toast with the validation detail; the modal stays open
toast — a non-session credential cannot create an account

emits.why: The create hook emits admin_action_performed with the account preset, and the route writes a durable create_account row to admin_audit_log.

offers.why: An internal operator tool renders no sponsored placement; no offers/placements table is reached from any file it owns.

metering.why: Nothing here is billable or quota-bearing: no usage_events / ledger write is reached from this surface or its contracts.

config.why: No logic_variables row is read on either arm; the presets and the radius cap are code constants.

sharing.why: The directory row shape is the same joined user_profiles/entitlements projection the detail page reads, and every row links into that surface.

limitations.what: The create audit row is written outside the provisioning transaction
limitations.measured: The user_profiles/entitlements transaction commits first and the audit INSERT follows, so an audit failure leaves a committed provisioned account reported to the operator as a 500.

limitations.what: GET returns the raw joined rows
limitations.measured: The response is ok(rowsRes.rows, ...) — the column whitelist is enforced only by the SELECT list, so a widened SELECT widens the payload with no code change at the boundary.

limitations.what: The measured create_modal_open state has no member in the states[] vocabulary
limitations.measured: Opening the create dialog is a real render branch; the closed set has no modal/dialog member.
limitations.check_id: none — vocabulary gap, escalated per Spec 128 §4

limitations.what: touch_target_min_px has no legal answer for a desktop-only admin page
limitations.measured: The schema allows only UNRESEARCHED or an integer >= 44, and nothing in this surface declares a 44px floor (grep for min-h-[44 / h-11 over its owned files returns nothing).
limitations.check_id: none — vocabulary gap, escalated per Spec 128 §4

notes: /api/admin/users serves both GET (directory, built by a query-string helper in src/features/admin-users/api/useAdminUsers.ts) and POST (create). The filter state lives in a Zustand store (useUserDirectoryStore); `offset` is a raw row offset, not a page index. The stripe_cancel_failed filter is the Spec 21 Sec 6 sweep surface for accounts whose delete-time cancellation failed. Hooks and store live under src/features/, outside src/components/, so excluded from files. identity.owner is UNRESEARCHED estate-wide: no owner registry exists in the tree, so naming one would be an invention rather than a measurement. a11y.touch_target_min_px is UNRESEARCHED because its vocabulary (UNRESEARCHED or an integer >= 44) has no member for a desktop-only admin page that declares no floor. Across the whole estate only 6 of 20 mutating admin handlers write an admin_audit_log row (users POST, users/[uid] PATCH, the two subscription-ops POSTs, mfa/verify POST, mfa DELETE); the users surfaces are five of those six.

measured_gate.why: classifyRoute('/admin/users') matches the admin-pages arm via `pathname.startsWith('/admin/')` -> 'admin'.

programme.why: An admin surface that operates the PLATFORM (users, entitlements, security, tunables, pipeline health) rather than either product specifically.
